message.content:
Using integration by parts with \(u = \log(x)\) and \(dv = dx\):

\[
\int \log(x)\,dx = x*\log(x) - \int x*\frac{1}{x}\,dx
\]

\[
= x*\log(x) - \int 1\,dx
\]

\[
= x*\log(x) - x + C
\]

<answer>x*log(x) - x + C</answer>
